scope: User-authorized trial integration of three-state ambient system and missing world sounds. Existing approved Stalker/pistol/casings/door/pickups preserved.

ambienceSources.processing: Original10s sources -> overlap-wrapped9s PCM loops, matched levels and gentle spectral shaping of added layers. Reused StatePreviewV2 family.

newCues.name: step-concrete-01
newCues.prompt: One natural footstep of a rubber-soled work boot on a dry concrete floor. Restrained dull weight, short sole friction, close clean foley, minimal room tail. A single isolated contact, no walking sequence, no music, voices or exaggerated bass.

newCues.name: step-concrete-02
newCues.prompt: Single work-boot step on matte concrete, soft heel thud followed immediately by a light sole scuff. Natural restrained close foley, dry short tail. One contact only, no sequence, voices, music or cinematic effects.

newCues.name: step-tile-01
newCues.prompt: One rubber-soled boot step on indoor ceramic tile. Dull solid contact with a small hard-floor reflection, no squeak or ringing. Realistic quiet isolated footstep, one contact only, no music or voices.

newCues.name: step-tile-02
newCues.prompt: Single restrained shoe contact on an old tiled indoor floor. Muted heel knock and soft sole friction, short natural room tail, no high ringing. Clean isolated foley, no sequence, music or voices.

newCues.name: step-wood-01
newCues.prompt: One work-boot footstep on a sturdy wooden floor. Short low wooden contact, tiny sole scrape, minimal resonance. Realistic restrained isolated foley, no creaking event, no sequence, music or voices.

newCues.name: step-wood-02
newCues.prompt: Single rubber boot step on thick timber flooring. Muted warm wooden thud with slight grainy sole friction, short natural decay. Quiet realistic isolated contact, no long creak, music, voices or sequence.

newCues.name: flashlight-switch
newCues.prompt: One close mechanical thumb switch click on a handheld flashlight. Tiny plastic press with a restrained tactile snap, dry clean realistic foley, no electronic tone, music, voice or reverb.

newCues.name: pistol-empty
newCues.prompt: One dry trigger pull on an empty pistol. A restrained crisp mechanical click-clack with a short metal mechanism tail. Isolated close realistic foley. No gunshot, cartridge fall, music or voice.

newCues.name: impact-concrete-01
newCues.prompt: One bullet striking a concrete wall: short hard muted impact, tiny gritty chips scattering and settling immediately. Realistic dry close impact foley, no gunshot, explosion, ricochet whistle, music or voices.

newCues.name: impact-concrete-02
newCues.prompt: A single small-caliber bullet impact on rough concrete, compact sharp crack of material and a short dry sprinkle of grit. Restrained realistic foley. No firing weapon, explosion, long ringing, music or voices.

newCues.name: impact-wood-01
newCues.prompt: One pistol bullet impact into a thick wooden crate: brief hard wooden knock with short splinter crack and small debris. Realistic isolated dry foley, no gunshot, big explosion, music or voices.

provenance: New cues are generated trial foley, not recordings of real locations or firearms. No copying of reference soundtracks; no new monster cues or fake threats baked into ambience.
quality: Technical decode/level validation only; user auditory evaluation still required. Replacements limited to previously disabled generic concrete/wood impacts. Flesh hit ownership remains with Stalker audio.
secrets: Signed download URLs, machine configuration and tokens omitted.
